themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that assist in writing, reviewing, or debugging code, enhancing developer productivity and code quality.

themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Content focusing on AI agents that can autonomously conduct research tasks, from data gathering to analysis, often with human oversight.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing platforms and software that leverage AI to accelerate various research processes, including data analysis, hypothesis generation, and knowledge discovery.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI tools that condense large volumes of text, such as articles, reports, or meeting transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on the creation and use of artificial user personas or data for testing, research, and simulating user interactions.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles covering the application of AI in user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) design, including generative design tools and AI-assisted prototyping.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Content on using AI to automate or enhance the process of evaluating the usability and effectiveness of products and services.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles that analyze and interpret user feedback, reviews, and social media comments to gauge sentiment and identify key opinions.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to gather insights, analyze market trends, and inform product development decisions.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Content related to AI applications in hiring, candidate sourcing, and understanding the impact of AI on the job market.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
